story:
The east of Malmohus belongs to svartalfar, and they are not the svartalfar of Svarhamr. Their camps are full of bloodbinders and foisters and infiltrators, who attack strangers on sight, and the Dragonbane, asked whose they are, give answers that do not agree. The elders of Svarhamr say the eastern camps are the clan's outer watch, posted so long ago that they have forgotten who posted them and now trust nobody, the Dragonbane included. Odell the vault keeper, when he is in drink, says that they are the free clans from under Myrkwood, the ones who believe the thralls' story and trade with the drakulv, and that the elders call them the outer watch because it is easier than saying the word traitor in the meeting hall.

The eastern camps answer to Kariig, and Kariig is two svartalfar. They are twins, the camps say, born in the same hour in the deep places under Myrkwood, and their mother gave them one name because the svartalfar of that clan believe twins share a single soul and that naming them twice would split it. They are both bloodbinders by craft, blade-dancers who cut their own palms before a quarrel and fight with the blood still running, and they are hard to strike cleanly; svartalf scouts say a blow aimed at a Kariig as often as not finds empty air or the flat of a blade.

They do not call the camps when they are attacked. The bloodbinders say a twin needs no one but the other half of its soul, and the other half is never far. Brisa the beam-cutter, who has no love for the eastern camps, says the truth is that nobody in the east trusts anybody else enough to come when called, and that the twins are no exception.

What the Kariig want is the question Svarhamr cannot answer. The eastern camps watch the drakulv and do not fight them. They watch Svarhamr too. When a company of Midgard goes down the road south, the bloodbinders are on the heights to see it pass, and the elders of Svarhamr have stopped asking where the news goes afterwards.
legend: There are two Kariigs, twin svartalf bloodbinders, in the svartalf camps in the east of Malmohus, level 53, standing among foisters and bloodbinders. They parry and evade a bit, otherwise no abilities and not CC-immune. Their templates give them (and the eastern svartalf camps) no faction, so nobody gets called in, but the foisters and bloodbinders standing right next to them (51-56) will see the fight and join. Mez or clear the nearest svartalfar first, then take one twin at a time; the two Kariigs stand about two thousand units apart, so pulling one doesn't bring the other unless you drag the fight.

aggro: Svarhamr's dogs? Or the drakulv's? Tell me which, before you die.
The east watches. The east does not forgive.

loremasterTopic.text: Twin bloodbinders with one name, who hold the [svartalfar]'s eastern camps of Malmohus. Svarhamr's elders call the east their outer watch; Odell calls it something else. See [Desukva] and [Svarhamr].

bookPage: From the readings of Brisa the beam-cutter of Svarhamr: the eastern camps are not on our beam. We cut the dragon and her brood, not svartalfar, and whatever the elders say in the meeting hall, nobody has ever proposed cutting the Kariig. My teacher went east once, young, to see the twins. She said they stood back to back in the snow with their palms open and bleeding, and asked her which side Svarhamr was on, and when she said the clan's, they laughed and asked which clan. She said she did not have an answer, and that was the first time she had noticed.
